definitions.explanation: To make more in number or amount.

examples.english: To increase the number of people.

notes:
{増|ふ}やす means to increase something in number or amount.

TRANSITIVITY:
- Type: {他動詞|たどうし} (transitive)
- Pair: {増|ふ}える (intransitive - to increase by itself)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {人数|にんずう}を{増|ふ}やす: to increase the number of people
- {貯金|ちょきん}を{増|ふ}やす: to increase savings
- {売|う}り{上|あ}げを{増|ふ}やす: to increase sales
- {仲間|なかま}を{増|ふ}やす: to increase one's companions
- {語彙|ごい}を{増|ふ}やす: to increase vocabulary

CONTRAST WITH SIMILAR VERBS:
- {増|ふ}やす: to increase (quantity, number)
- {加|くわ}える: to add (to a group)
- {足|た}す: to add (math, supplement)
